title: Iowa State vs UCF: 3rd Quarter Point Total

contracts.label: More than 7.5 points scored in the 3rd quarter

content.value: This market resolves to Yes if Iowa State and UCF collectively score more than 7.5 points during the 3rd quarter of the College Football game between Iowa State and UCF scheduled for November 20, 2026 at 6:00 PM ET. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying is the total points scored by both teams during the 3rd quarter of the specified game, excluding all other periods and overtime.
